pages.avisoLegal.independencia.p1: BAQUEANO is an independent initiative and does not represent any government institution. Entities such as INTUR, MARENA, municipal governments, the National Police, Fire Department, Red Cross or other bodies are mentioned only for information purposes to guide the user. Their inclusion does not imply sponsorship, affiliation or official representation by those institutions.
pages.avisoLegal.independencia.p2: We are an independent platform focused on promoting sustainable and community tourism.
pages.avisoLegal.independencia.strong1: BAQUEANO is not an official website of the State of Nicaragua.

pages.avisoLegal.legalHeroSection.p1: Legal framework, transparency and operating conditions of BAQUEANO, a digital platform committed to authentic, responsible and safe tourism in Nicaragua.
pages.avisoLegal.marcoNormativo.p1: BAQUEANO's operation is governed by the legislation in force in the Republic of Nicaragua, including:
pages.avisoLegal.marcoNormativo.p2: Establishes the framework for the development, regulation and promotion of tourism in Nicaragua.
pages.avisoLegal.marcoNormativo.p3: Promotes the development of sustainable tourism investments and activities.
pages.avisoLegal.marcoNormativo.p4: Regulates the conservation of natural resources and the sustainable use of environmental heritage.
pages.avisoLegal.marcoNormativo.p5: Regulates digital transactions, the validity of electronic information and online services.
pages.avisoLegal.naturaleza.p1: BAQUEANO is a technology platform for information, direct connection and digital facilitation. It does not provide tourism services directly; instead it offers tools so travelers can discover destinations, contact local providers and organize their experiences safely and responsibly.
pages.avisoLegal.naturaleza.p2: Verified tourism, cultural and natural content.
pages.avisoLegal.naturaleza.p3: Between travelers and local providers, without abuses.
pages.avisoLegal.naturaleza.p4: Routes, distances and points of interest in real time.
pages.avisoLegal.propiedadIntelectual.p1: All content, design, logo, visual identity, interfaces, source code, database, texts, photographs, maps, icons and other elements of BAQUEANO are protected by intellectual property and copyright laws. Their reproduction, distribution, modification or unauthorized use without the prior written consent of the owner is prohibited.
pages.avisoLegal.titularidad.p1: BAQUEANO is a digital platform operated and managed from Managua, Nicaragua, with reach across the entire national territory. It aims to promote sustainable tourism through technology, making it easier to connect travelers with local providers (entrepreneurs, guides, cooperatives, farms, lodgings, eateries and experiences).

pages.baqueanoIa.iaBudgetCard.div1: Straight talk: in Nicaragua, eating at a local eatery costs C$ 120-180 per dish, while tourist restaurants run C$ 500-900. The intercity bus is the cheapest option, your own car saves money if you share fuel, and renting a vehicle gives you more flexibility. We also include supplies, crafts and voluntary support for communities.

pages.cookies.body.title1: Cookies and Local Storage | BAQUEANO Nicaragua
pages.cookies.cookiesHeroSection.p1: Transparency about how we use cookies, storage technologies and local data to give you a safe, authentic and personalized travel experience in Nicaragua.
pages.cookies.flowDiagramCard.h31: How does data work in BAQUEANO?
pages.cookies.flowDiagramCard.p1: This is how the technologies connect to give you a safe, personalized experience.
pages.cookies.flowDiagramCard.p4: Authentication and Hosting: account management and security.
pages.cookies.flowDiagramCard.p5: Main database: destinations, bookings and content.
pages.cookies.general.h31: What are cookies and local storage?
pages.cookies.general.p1: Cookies are small text files saved in your browser or device to remember information and improve your experience. BAQUEANO also uses local storage technologies (LocalStorage, SessionStorage and IndexedDB) and Service Workers to enable advanced features such as offline mode, saved routes and better performance on expeditions without signal.
pages.cookies.preferencias.p1: You can customize the use of cookies and local data to your preferences. Essential cookies and necessary storage are required for the site to work.
pages.cookies.preferencias.p2: Required for operation, security and authentication.
pages.cookies.preferencias.p3: They store your language, theme, region and settings.
pages.cookies.preferencias.p4: Routes, guides, maps and resources for offline use.
pages.cookies.preferencias.p5: Helps us improve the BAQUEANO experience.
pages.cookies.preferencias.p6: You can change your preferences at any time and delete your local data from this device.
pages.cookies.trustStripSection.p1: We don't use cookies to show third-party ads or track your habits.
pages.cookies.trustStripSection.p2: Your location is requested only when you enable it for routes and maps.
pages.cookies.trustStripSection.p3: You can manage and delete your local data whenever you want with one click.
pages.cookies.trustStripSection.p4: Enjoy content, maps, routes and guides even without signal in remote areas.
